text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's birthday live is coming up. 
The two of us decided to review the 
special video gift for her fans together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! The limited-edition cake is so 
cute♪ As expected of the Umamusume Top 100 
Sweets Shop☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this is part of trend research, 
right? So it's totally fine to eat before 
lunch~☆ ...Oh, gotta take a photo for 
Umastagram too♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
""...Huh? Where's my smartphone? I'm sure 
I put it in my bag! Waaah! Where did it 
go~?!""

It's rare footage capturing Smart Falcon's 
everyday life. Even her being terrible at 
keeping things tidy is charming in its own 
way.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, looking pretty good, wouldn't you 
say!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I know you're right, but... Hmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't this just be the same as usual? 
It's a birthday live, after all, so I feel 
like it's missing that special something.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to know Falco on an even 
deeper level! And close the gap between me 
and all my fans by a whole, whole lot!"

I want to show a side of her she's never 
shown before. If that's the case, it would 
be best to ask someone who knows her 
deeply for help.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try consulting your parents?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That might be good♪ I'll go ask and see!

And when Smart Falcon consulted her 
parents, a reply was sent back right away.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There's a video attached! What could 
it be? Let's watch it together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this a video from when we had a 
Christmas party as a family? Huh, then who 
is this little kid—"

text_block_list.name: Young Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Lots and lots~♪ I'll give it all to you~♪ 
Mwah☆"

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Kyaa~♪ So cute~! Encore, encore☆"

text_block_list.name: Young Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Ehehe♪ Mwah, mwah, mwah☆"

A tiny Smart Falcon blows kisses to the 
camera. Again and again—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah! Turn it off, turn it off~! —What 
is this?! Dad, you actually had a video 
like this?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's true that it's treasured 
footage I haven't shown to anyone else, 
but... uuugh..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahhn, stop it~!! I-It's... so 
embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Huh? Another video came in. And a 
message too...?

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"How was the video? Came out great, right? 
I still have plenty of footage from when 
you used to play idol back then."

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever Mom and I praised her, her eyes 
would light up and she'd perform it again 
and again. Ah, good times."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, was that so...?

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"And the video I just sent is of when she 
started singing outside and we couldn't do 
our shopping. Hahaha, what a predicament 
that was!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, did I really do something like that? 
...Maybe I did. Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I sang, my father and mother 
looked so happy. I just loved seeing their 
faces like that."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, not just the two of us. The people in 
the shopping district, our friends—seeing 
everyone's happy faces!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...This small concert is my beginning. 
The starting point of my dream—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a bit embarrassing, but let's 
play this video during my next birthday 
live!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to know where my dream 
began!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Maybe I'll sing the song 
from my video on stage too☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone, "Look how much 
Falco's grown~♪"☆

Smart Falcon headed off to her lesson, 
frolicking excitedly like a child!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, another message from Dad! 'I've got 
more secret videos in my stash, want 
'em?'... he says.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if we do too many, it won't feel 
special anymore, right? Let's save the 
rest for next time as a treat♪

"Looking forward to the day when even more 
precious footage will be unveiled, she 
carried on with preparations for the 
birthday live!"
